NewsArticle.Title: Trap Trouble Under Investigation
NewsArticle.Content: We are investigating into the reports about trap damage having decreased. We hope to have this matter concluded by Friday, 11/10 at the latest. We are sorry for any inconvience this might cause in the meantime. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
